_doc: Format of content/signup-provider-test.json, which tools/test-signup-live.mjs writes only after a live test on a TEST list in which every case passed. build.py --with-signup is refused without that file, and refuses this example. Do not write the record by hand: run the harness (docs/email-signup.md).
list: Name of the test list or newsletter used (never the live list)
tested_by: Name of the person who ran the test and answered its questions

invalid_address.observed: e.g. 'not-an-address: 400 invalid, provider not called; nwpt-signup-test@example.invalid: 400 rejected'

confirmation_email.observed: operator: the confirmation email arrived and its link confirmed the address

repeat_address.observed: e.g. 'HTTP 400, outcome rejected; operator: accurate (address listed once, still confirmed)'

unsubscribe.observed: operator: the unsubscribe link in a test email worked and the provider shows the address as unsubscribed

provider_outage.observed: e.g. 'connection refused: 502 unconfirmed; provider 503: 502 unconfirmed; no answer: 504 unconfirmed after 8.0 s; wrong key: 503 refused'
